title: Place Value to 1000: Hundreds, Tens and Ones
seo_title: Grade 2 Place Value Worksheets: Hundreds, Tens and Ones, Expanded Form and Base-Ten Blocks
domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standard_text: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones; e.g., 706 equals 7 hundreds, 0 tens, and 6 ones. Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a hundred. Read and write numbers to 1000 using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form.
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 place value worksheets: count base-ten blocks, hundreds, tens and ones, value of a digit, expanded form, number names to 1000 and regrouping like 13 tens. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: A 3-digit number is hundreds, tens and ones. 10 tens make 1 hundred.
key_sub: 706 = 7 hundreds, 0 tens, 6 ones = 700 + 6. The 0 holds the tens place, so “seven hundred six” is 706, not 7006 or 76.
body_html:
Each digit has a place

A 3-digit number has a hundreds digit, a tens digit and a ones digit. The place tells you what the digit is worth. 10 ones make 1 ten. 10 tens make 1 hundred.

The place value chart

Value of a digit

What is the value of the 6 in 635?

The 6 is in the hundreds place. 6 hundreds = 600.

Answer: 600

Three ways to write a number

Way243706
Base-ten numeral243706
Number nametwo hundred forty-threeseven hundred six
Expanded form200 + 40 + 3700 + 6
Hundreds, tens, ones2 hundreds, 4 tens, 3 ones7 hundreds, 0 tens, 6 ones

Use a hyphen for numbers like forty-three. Do not say “and” in a whole number.

Zero holds a place

706 has 0 tens. The 0 keeps the 7 in the hundreds place. Without it, 706 would turn into 76.

Write the number

Write “three hundred six” as a number.

3 hundreds, 0 tens, 6 ones. Write 3, 0, 6.

Answer: 306

More than 9 tens

5 hundreds, 13 tens, 2 ones = ?

13 tens = 1 hundred and 3 tens. So it is 6 hundreds, 3 tens, 2 ones.

Answer: 632

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing “three hundred six” as 3006Use only 3 digits: 306
Writing 306 as 36 or 360Put the 0 in the tens place: 306
Giving the digit, not its value (the 4 in 243 is 4)The 4 is in the tens place: 40
Mixing up tens and ones (4 tens, 3 ones = 34)Tens come first: 43
Writing 13 tens as 13 in the tens place (5132)13 tens = 130: 500 + 130 + 2 = 632

faq.q: What place value should a 2nd grader know?
faq.a: Grade 2 students learn that a 3-digit number is made of hundreds, tens and ones, and that 10 tens make 1 hundred. They read and write numbers up to 1000 as numerals, number names and expanded form.

faq.q: What is expanded form in 2nd grade math?
faq.a: Expanded form shows the value of each digit as a sum. For example, 432 = 400 + 30 + 2, and 706 = 700 + 6.

faq.q: How do you teach place value with base-ten blocks?
faq.a: Let the child build a number with flats (hundreds), rods (tens) and cubes (ones), then count each kind and write the digits in order. Trading 10 rods for 1 flat shows that 10 tens make 1 hundred.

faq.q: Why does my child write 3006 for three hundred six?
faq.a: They write each part they hear: 300 and then 6. Show that “three hundred six” is 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones, so it has only 3 digits: 306.

items.q: I am a 3-digit number. My hundreds digit is 5. My tens digit is 0. My ones digit is 3 more than my hundreds digit. What number am I?

items.e: Hundreds: 4. Tens: 4 + 2 = 6. Ones: 0. The number is 460.

items.q: Pencils come in boxes of 100 and packs of 10. Ben buys 3 boxes, 4 packs and 7 single pencils. How many pencils does he have?
items.e: 3 boxes = 300. 4 packs = 40. 7 single pencils = 7. 300 + 40 + 7 = 347.

items.q: A baker has 600 cookies. She puts 10 cookies in each bag. How many bags does she fill?
items.e: 600 is 6 hundreds. Each hundred is 10 tens, so 600 = 60 tens. She fills 60 bags.
